Identification_Area.title: Workbench for Imaging Spectroscopy Exploration and Research (WISER)

Archive_Resource.name: Workbench for Imaging Spectroscopy Exploration and Research (WISER)
Archive_Resource.description: WISER (Workbench for Imaging Spectroscopy Exploration and Research) is an open-source, cross-platform GUI for visualizing and analyzing hyperspectral imagery. Built in Python on Qt/PySide6, it runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux with no commercial license required. It has support for many multi-spectral planetary data sets like CRISM and OMEGA. Version 3.x of WISER introduces more geospatial support and mosaicking options. Many raster formats are supported including PDS4 (via GDAL integration).
